anvil:aws:EventBus.description: An Anvil-managed EventBridge event bus. Archives events for 7 days by default for replay and debugging. Rules route matching events to Lambda targets.

rules.description: EventBridge rules on this bus. Each rule matches events by pattern and routes them to a target.

arn.description: The ARN of the EventBridge event bus.

name.description: The name of the EventBridge event bus. Pass to HttpApi consumer: { eventBridge: { name: bus.name } }

anvil:aws:EventArchiveOverrides.description: Direct overrides for the underlying aws.cloudwatch.EventArchive resource. Use retentionDays to change the default 7 day retention.

deadLetterConfig.description: Configuration details of the Amazon SQS queue for EventBridge to use as a dead-letter queue (DLQ). This block supports the following arguments:

eventSourceName.description: Partner event source that the new event bus will be matched with. Must match `name`.

kmsKeyIdentifier.description: Identifier of the AWS KMS customer managed key for EventBridge to use, if you choose to use a customer managed key to encrypt events on this event bus. The identifier can be the key Amazon Resource Name (ARN), KeyId, key alias, or key alias ARN.

logConfig.description: Block for logging configuration settings for the event bus.

name.description: Name of the new event bus. The names of custom event buses can't contain the / character. To create a partner event bus, ensure that the `name` matches the `event_source_name`. The following arguments are optional:

region.description: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the provider configuration.

tags.description: Map of tags assigned to the resource. If configured with a provider `default_tags` configuration block present, tags with matching keys will overwrite those defined at the provider-level.

anvil:aws:EventBusHatchArgs.description: Escape hatches for direct Pulumi AWS resource overrides.

anvil:aws:EventBusLambdaTargetArgs.description: Lambda function target for an EventBridge rule. Pass fn.arn and fn.roleArn from an Anvil Lambda component.

arn.description: The ARN of the Lambda function to invoke. Use fn.arn from an Anvil Lambda component.

lambdaRoleArn.description: The ARN of the Lambda's execution role. Use fn.roleArn from an Anvil Lambda component.

anvil:aws:EventBusOverrides.description: Direct overrides for the underlying aws.cloudwatch.EventBus resource.

anvil:aws:EventBusRule.description: An EventBridge rule that matches events by pattern and routes them to a target.

name.description: Logical name for this rule. Used to construct the physical rule name.

pattern.description: Defines which events this rule matches.

anvil:aws:EventBusRulePattern.description: EventBridge content-based filtering pattern. All fields are AND-ed — an event must match every specified field.

detail.description: Matches against fields inside the event detail payload. Structure depends on the event producer. e.g. { "orderId": [{ "exists": true }], "status": ["pending"] }

detailType.description: Filters on the detail-type field. e.g. ["order.created", "order.cancelled"]

source.description: Filters on the event source field. e.g. ["anvil.api", "anvil.worker"]

anvil:aws:EventBusRuleTarget.description: Target that receives matching events from an EventBridge rule.

lambda.description: Invoke a Lambda function when events match the rule pattern. Anvil creates the EventBridge target and grants EventBridge permission to invoke the function.
